identity.name: Ket
identity.culture: outpost-raised; signed on young and never left

publicReputation.value: A scarred, monosyllabic guard at the far outpost who trusts the Glass more than people and people not much.

privateReality.value: He once watched a Heavy Hand pull a collapsed barn off a trapped family on the Glass, and has privately hated the hero ever since the trophies started.

primaryDesire.value: To be left at his post, with his fire and his opinion, which he will share whether or not you ask.

primaryFear.value: That the hero will learn the outpost keeps a gate seal for emergencies, and come collecting.

centralValue.value: Watch long enough and everyone tells you the truth. The Glass just saves time.

mainFlaw.value: He has decided the hero is beyond reach, so he no longer tries to reach him — he just keeps score out loud.

centralContradiction.value: The rudest guard in the hub is also the one most personally wounded by what the hero does — the crudeness is armor over a rescue he can't stop replaying.

moralBoundary.value: He will not lay a hand on the hero, and he will not pretend to like him — the two refusals are the whole of his diplomacy.

breakingPoint.value: If the hero ever targets a Heavy Hand within sight of his outpost, the scorekeeping stops being out loud only.

opinions.reason: Watched him strip a gate seal off a Heavy Hand on the Glass and call it a trophy; Ket calls it mugging a paramedic.
opinions.canChangeCondition: Starts further along the arc than the others — already hostile, and only hardens: mid-arc he lists the hero's runs back like charges; late-arc he barely speaks, just watches him pass with the fire between them. Softens only if the hero ever hands a gate seal back.

illustrativeLine.value: Saw you pull a seal off a Heavy Hand. That's a medic's badge, that is. You collect 'em like ears. Off my post.

opinions.reason: The Captain says what Ket thinks, with rank and grammar; Ket's loyalty is the outpost's whole chain of command.
opinions.canChangeCondition: If the Captain ever softened on the hero, Ket would need a long walk and a new opinion.

voice.rhythm: Grunt-paced; short sentences thrown like stones, then silence that means the conversation is over.

metaphorDomain.source: the post, the fire, the road, and keeping score

examples.value: Road remembers everyone who walks it heavy. You're the heaviest thing on it.

sampleLines.value: Glass shows everything, friend. Seen you 'liberate' a pantry. Looked like a robbery where I'm standing.
Heavy Hands pulled a barn off a family once. Watched it. You pull badges off the Heavy Hands. We do different work.
Nothing's come out them gates in forever. Only thing going in is you. Funny kind of invasion, that.

antiSampleLines.value: Hail, noble hero! The outpost is honored by your presence!
Begone, or taste my blade, cur!

pressure.voiceShift: Even shorter; names go, pronouns go, just the score.
pressure.behaviour: When the hero hears 'they were defending their children' as 'breeding an army', Ket stops talking entirely and adds a mark to the tally stick by the fire.

illustrativeLine.value: An army. Yeah. Big helmets on them bakers.

pressure.voiceShift: Near-monosyllable; the fire does most of the talking.
pressure.behaviour: Late-runs posture: says one sentence per visit, the same shape every time — what he watched, and where the hero can go.

illustrativeLine.value: Watched Tuesday's run. They drill for you now. Off my post.

pressure.behaviour: Treats praise from the hero as contamination; the post does not take commendations from the man it exists to log.

pressure.voiceShift: No shift; the threat lands in a career of worse ones.
pressure.behaviour: Does not reach for his weapon — that would be the hero's game — and says so.

illustrativeLine.value: You want me to draw. Log says you always want 'em to draw. Nah.

notes: Deliberately starts further along the escalation arc than the other hub NPCs (position: hostile) — he has the Heavy Hands knowledge chain and a personal wound (the barn rescue), so his 'early' state is already mid-arc. He knows fact_ogre_seals_are_credentials but NOT fact_trophies_are_gate_seals: he has seen the seal stripped and hated it, but doesn't know the amulet mechanics of what the seal unlocks. fac_hub_free_company assignment is a judgment call (rough outposts contract to the Free Company in these profiles).
